scope: Every currently named lever has a concrete evaluation, theorem boundary, or unresolved dependency. Exhausting accessible tests is not proving every scientific objective.

levers.name: native_temperature_derivative
levers.evidence: PP branching derivative omission matches the frozen-state error; correction residual <3e-8. The original binary and failure are preserved.

levers.name: reaction_channels
levers.evidence: 63 whole-network grouped interventions reproduce heat/nu/native derivatives; isolated-channel and individual-PP failures retained.

levers.name: composition_and_energy
levers.evidence: 22-component vector reconstructed from channel outputs/source Q. Direct native vector and independent time-step comparison absent; F-free manifold not invariant.

levers.name: common_EOS_and_global_derivatives
levers.evidence: Default small-step EOS differences do not converge; HELM full-domain control also fails. Local numerical agreement cannot certify global errors.

levers.name: GR_heat_and_composition_evolution
levers.evidence: Conservative frozen-coefficient controls pass energy tests. Closed boundary exits the local regime; radiative boundary still changes local T by about 15%. No species/metric/density/opacity updates.

levers.name: GR_scalar_stability_response
levers.evidence: Curved-background monopole scattering and an explicit conditional scalar stability bound; no full stellar mode or binary transfer claim.

levers.name: fluid_thermal_scalar_coupling
levers.evidence: Buoyancy diagnostic has agreeing negative regions. At phi0=0 thermal modes decouple linearly; finite-background Schur residue needs the missing cross derivatives.

levers.name: complete_nonlinear_observation
levers.evidence: No certified time-dependent three-body force and photon/noise/pulse forward model follows from a static mass or a monopole scattering coefficient. Existing raw observational failures remain frozen.

levers.name: final_submission
levers.evidence: Request12 PDF/ZIP are historical. A conditional methodology paper needs manuscript integration and claim-scoped review; full observational closure is required only for the stronger physical claims.

repo_boundary: AGENTS.md excludes runtime/build-environment and additional pulsar/LLR empirical work. No such work was reopened. A mathematical missing specification is not solved by requesting the same approval again.
